about: Habitats: where a region's flora stands. water: 'dry' (never in water), 'standing' (may stand in still water up to depth_max_m; never in flowing water), 'seabed' (below the sea or lake surface, depth_min_m..depth_max_m). density_per_ha: all flora refs per hectare, from the study's measured densities (section 3) unless noted. families: the share of the habitat's refs each family takes.

habitats.name: Mangrove fringe
habitats.about: Tidal mud and shallow brackish water at the coast and estuary edge. Density: BM1/BM2 mangrove and reed refs in flooded nodes.

habitats.name: Cypress swamp
habitats.about: Bald cypress over black water and mud with knees, moss and ferns. Density: KoTM LALPAMud01 148/ha.

habitats.name: Drowned forest
habitats.about: Forest standing in permanent still water, 0.3 to 3 m deep (hard cap 3.5 m). Density: BM2 flooded trees 60/ha plus shrubs and reeds.

habitats.name: Reed marsh
habitats.about: Reed and cattail beds in shallow still water and wet mud. Density: BM1 reeds 194/ha flooded; most of a marsh is groundcover grass, so the object layer is lighter.

habitats.name: Open still water
habitats.about: Ponds, pools and slow backwaters: lily patches and water weed only. Density: KoTM LALPARiverBottom01 27/ha.

habitats.name: Swamp hummock
habitats.about: Firm wet ground between channels: dense shrub, tree, fern. Density: BM2 LPineForest03 (the swamp ground) 198/ha.

habitats.name: Hist grove
habitats.about: Root-hummocks round the great Hist trees, deep moss and fungus.

habitats.name: Rainforest floor
habitats.about: Closed jungle on firm ground: emergent hardwoods, mid-canopy, undergrowth, ferns, fungus. Density: KoTM LALPARainforestNG 130/ha.

habitats.name: Riverine forest
habitats.about: Gallery forest on banks and levees beside rivers; never in the flowing water. Density: KoTM trees 60/ha within 10 m of water plus understorey.

habitats.name: Dry hammock
habitats.about: Raised firm ground, mounds and island interiors: palms, erut and bottle trees, scrub. Density: between KoTM rainforest (130) and marsh grass (39).

habitats.name: Upland scrub
habitats.about: Ridge and mesa tops: tall grass, thorn scrub, stunted trees, rock. Density: BM2 LFieldGrass02 56/ha.

habitats.name: Coastal grassland
habitats.about: Open grass behind the shore, salt-tolerant shrubs, scattered trees. Density: KoTM LALPAMarshGrass 39/ha.

habitats.name: Beach and shore
habitats.about: Sand, shingle and mud-flat edges above the tide: palms, driftwood, rock. Density: KoTM palms 24/ha within 10 m of water.

habitats.name: Rocky outcrop
habitats.about: Rock outcrops, crags and the foot of cliffs: boulders clumped (KoTM R 0.52) and the cliff-foot pile layer (study rec. 4). Density: vanilla boulders 20 to 38/ha.

habitats.name: Cliff face
habitats.about: Slopes of 28 deg and more: cliff pieces with their open back uphill. Density: vanilla cliffs 5.7 to 12.5/ha.

habitats.name: Lake and river-mouth bed
habitats.about: Fresh or brackish still bed below the surface: kelp, weed, clams. Density: Depths median 3 refs per 0.34 ha cell.

habitats.name: Seabed, shallow (0 to 5 m)
habitats.about: Coral and kelp shallows. Depths depth band 2-5 m holds 983 of 4,238 refs.

habitats.name: Seabed, mid (5 to 20 m)
habitats.about: Kelp, moss rocks and clams. Depths bands 5-10 m 367 and 10-20 m 857 refs.

habitats.name: Seabed, deep (20 to 80 m)
habitats.about: Tall seaweed forests, clams and rock on the deep floor. Depths bands 20-40 m 1,093 and 40-80 m 831 refs.
